_doc: Dao insights (Dao system). A character holds {insight_id: {level, progress}} (CharacterData.dao). Each level (up to max_level) makes every matching technique (its element is in the insight's elements, or its id is in techniques) stronger by technique_bonus (0.1 = +10% of its bonuses) and adds breakthrough_bonus to every breakthrough chance. Insights are gained three ways: the dao_insight effect key (rare encounters: +1 level), practicing a matching technique (each practice day adds 1 progress, also toward a first level), and contemplating an insight you already have in seclusion (each day adds seclusion_mult progress). When progress reaches progress_needed[level] a Comprehension check is rolled: chance = check.base + (comprehension - 10) * check.per_comprehension, clamped to [check.min, check.max]. Success grants a level and resets progress; failure keeps failure_keep of it.

insights.name: Sword Dao
insights.description: The intent of the blade: to cut through everything, including hesitation.

insights.name: Fire Dao
insights.description: Flame consumes and renews. Fire arts burn hotter in your hands.

insights.name: Water Dao
insights.description: Water yields and yet wears down mountains.

insights.name: Dao of Life
insights.description: The patience of roots and the stubbornness of spring.

insights.name: Dao of Breath
insights.description: Qi enters, qi leaves. Everything else follows.

insights.name: Thunder Dao
insights.description: Heaven's punishment and heaven's decree. Those who understand the lightning fear their tribulations a little less.

insights.name: Dao of Wind
insights.description: Formless, it goes where it likes and nothing can grasp it.

insights.name: Dao of Space
insights.description: Distance is a habit of the mind. A glimpse of it folds every step and steadies every breakthrough.

insights.name: Dao of Slaughter
insights.description: Killing intent distilled from ten thousand deaths. Blood arts grow savage in your hands, but it opens no door to heaven.

insights.name: Vajra Dao
insights.description: The diamond-hard compassion of the Buddhist guardians: unmoving, unbreaking, unwilling to strike first.
